figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Enfumafungin-type natural products and their unique structural features. (A) Structures of the enfumafungin-type scaffold and
representative enfumafungin-type antibiotics. (B) The enzymatic fusion patterns in the fungal natural product biosynthesis. (C) C−C bond
cleavage catalyzed by different types of oxidases.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Biosynthesis of fuscoatroside. (A) Schematic representation of the fuscoatroside gene cluster from H. fuscoatra NRRL 22980. (B) LC-MS
analysis of the coexpression of the proposed fuscoatroside (1) biosynthesis genes in A. oryzae NSAR1 with purposeful combinations, which
successfully resulted in the generation of 1. (C) LC-MS analysis of mycelium extracts from A. oryzae NSAR1 expressing different combinations of
fsoA/D/E/F. The values in parentheses represent the magnification of the extracted mass spectrum of the feature attribute. Panel (D) proposed the
biosynthetic pathway of fuscoatroside.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Verification of the function of the TC-GT fusion enzyme.
(A) HPLC-MS analysis of mycelium extracts from AO, AO-fsoA(TC),
AO-fsoA(TC) + fsoA(GT), and AO-fsoA. (B) Scheme for domain
swapping of efuA and fsoA. (C) HPLC-MS analysis of mycelium
extracts from AO, AO-efuA(TC), and AO-efuA(TC)fsoA(GT).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Functional characterization of the P450 enzyme FsoE. (A) HPLC analysis of mycelium extracts of A. oryzae harboring fsoE supplemented
with 9 and 10, respectively; panel (B) proposed the catalytic mechanism for FsoE-mediated cleavage of C−C bond in the E-ring; (C) partial 13C
NMR spectra of fuscoatroside (1) labeled with sodium [2-13C, 2-2H3] acetate. (D) The predicted amino acid residues (green stick) interacting with
substrate 10 (yellow stick) in the active pocket of FsoE. Substrate 10 sits in a hydrophobic active pocket (the negatively charged regions are shown
in red, the positively charged regions are shown in blue, and the hydrophobic regions are shown in white). (E) The results of feeding experiment
assays of compound 9 with site-directed mutants of FsoE.
